name: karagoz-mcp
description: Device automation for Android emulators and phones, iOS simulators and iPhones: a CLI and an MCP server.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --splitting --outdir=dist && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('src/drivers/ios/ax-helper.swift', 'dist/ax-helper.swift'); for (const d of ['KaragozRunner.xcodeproj', 'KaragozRunner']) fs.cpSync('../ios-runner/' + d, 'dist/ios-runner/' + d, { recursive: true, filter: (f) => !f.includes('xcuserdata') })"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "for (const f of ['README.md', 'LICENSE']) require('fs').copyFileSync('../../' + f, f)"
